summary: Wheeler REIT filed an 8-K reporting September 2026 redemptions of its Series D Cumulative Convertible Preferred Stock: eight holders redeemed 8,200 shares at roughly $41.66 per share, settled via issuance of 348,896 common shares. Because the lowest conversion price of Series D stock was about $0.98, the indenture governing the 7.00% Subordinated Convertible Notes due 2031 automatically adjusted the notes' conversion price down to approximately $0.54 per share, a 45% discount to $0.98. No board recommendation or advisor is named; this is a mechanical indenture reset tied to preferred redemptions, not an M&A or activist event. What to watch: continued monthly Series D redemptions and common-share issuance driving dilution, and the depressed note conversion price creating a large common overhang.
